findings.passage: I fully support our US Constitution, including each of the amendments. I was raised in a household with guns and am part of a family in which hunting, and fishing are valued. I believe Oregonians have a unique relationship with firearms that center on respect and responsibility.
findings.note: Written vote explanation filed with the Senate secretary on her yes vote on SB 554; states her general view on the Constitution and Oregonians' relationship with firearms.
subjects: Second Amendment and gun rights statement

findings.passage: This is not a mandate nor, in my view, is it an expression on my opinions on the Second Amendment but rather an expression of my support for allowing local voices to make decisions that work for their community. I believe we need to take reasonable steps to keep Oregonians, particularly our students, safe from gun violence and this gives local jurisdictions the ability to make that decision, if they so choose.
findings.note: Explains her yes vote on SB 554 as support for letting local governments decide whether to allow guns in or around public buildings such as schools.
subjects: guns in public buildings and schools
local control of gun rules

findings.passage: I am committed to supporting reasonable gun safety laws that protect both the Second Amendment and protect the lives of Oregonians.
